Short title and commencement

PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
ACT XXXI OF 1975
An Act to provide for the levy and collection of tax on certain lands in
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd A 1975).
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Act may be called Punjab Lands Improvement Tax Act,
1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
ACT XXXI OF 1975
An Act to provide for the levy and collection of tax on certain lands in
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd A 1975).
2. Definitions.-(1) In
this Act unless there is anything repugnant in t subject or eontext,-
(a) 'Land' means the land assessed to land revenue ; (b)
'Local Area' means the areas specified in the Schedule ; (c) 'Schedule' means
the schedule appended to this Act ; and (d) 'Tax' means the tax levied under
this Act,
(2) The words and expressions
used but not defined shall bear the same meaning as they bear in the West
Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967.

Application of the Act

PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
ACT XXXI OF 1975
An Act to provide for the levy and collection of tax on certain lands in
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd A 1975).
3. Application of the Act.-This
Act shall apply to the lands situated in the local areas specified in the
Schedule.

Tax on lands in the local arears

PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
ACT XXXI OF 1975
An Act to provide for the levy and collection of tax on certain lands in
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd A 1975).
4. Tax on lands in the local
arears.-There shall be levied and collected tax from the owners of the
lands situated in the local areas at the rate of Rs. 3.75 per acre per annum
for a period of 12 years.

Levy, collection and recovery of tax

PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
ACT XXXI OF 1975
An Act to provide for the levy and collection of tax on certain lands in
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd A 1975).
5. Levy, collection and
recovery of tax.-Tax shall be levied and collected in such manner as may be
prescribed and the arrears of it may be recovered as if it were arrears of land
revenue.

Power to modify the Schedule

PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
ACT XXXI OF 1975
An Act to provide for the levy and collection of tax on certain lands in
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd A 1975).
6. Power to modify the
Schedule.-Government may add to or modify entries in the Schedule from time
to time by notification in the official Gazette.

Power to make rules

PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
ACT XXXI OF 1975
An Act to provide for the levy and collection of tax on certain lands in
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd A 1975).
7. Power to make rules.-Government
may make rules to carry out the purposes of this Act.

Repeal of Punjab Ordinance No. I of 1975

PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
PUNJAB LANDS IMPROVEMENT TAX ACT, 1975
ACT XXXI OF 1975
An Act to provide for the levy and collection of tax on certain lands in
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 3rd April 1975]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 3rd A 1975).
8. Repeal of Punjab Ordinance
No. I of 1975.-The Punjab Lands Improvement Tax Ordinance, 1975 (Punjab
Ordinance No. I of 1975), is hereby repealed.
